blocks.text: Biodiversity, jo 'biological diversity' se bana lafz hai, mukhtalif ecosystems mein zindagi ki shaklon ki rang-a-rangi (variety) ko kehte hain. Is mein species ki, genes ki aur ecosystems ki diversity shamil hai. Yeh jandaron (organism) ki bharmaar aur un ke ek doosre ke saath aur apne mahol (environment) ke saath talluqaat ko zahir karti hai.

blocks.title: Ecosystem
blocks.text: Ecosystem ek harkat karta hua, ek doosre par asar daalne wala nizam (system) hai jo jandaron aur un ke maddi mahol (physical environment) se bana hai. Is mein tamam biotic factors (zinda cheezein) aur abiotic factors (ghair-zinda cheezein, jaise paani, mitti, hawa, roshni) shamil hain.

blocks.title: Niche
blocks.text: Niche ecosystem ke andar kisi jandar ya species ka kirdar ya kaam hai. Is mein us ka habitat (maskan), doosre jandaron ke saath talluqaat (shikaar yani predation, muqabla yani competition, aur symbiosis) aur ecosystem mein energy ke bahao mein us ka kirdar shamil hai.
Biodiversity ko kin darjon (level) par jaancha jata hai
Biodiversity ki jaanch (assessment) kai darjon (levels) par hoti hai, aur har darja zindagi ki pecheedgi ke bare mein apni alag maloomat deta hai.

items: Species level: kisi ilaqe mein maujood mukhtalif species ko pehchaan kar aur gin kar biodiversity jaanchi jati hai. Species diversity mein sirf species ki tadaad (number) nahi, balke un ki nisbati tadaad (relative abundance) aur phailao (distribution) bhi shamil hain.

Genetic level: biodiversity ka matlab yahan ek species ke tamam afraad mein maujood genetic maloomat ki rang-a-rangi hai. Genetic diversity species ke adapt hone aur zinda rehne ke liye nihayat zaroori hai, kyunke isi se species mahol ki tabdeeliyon (change) aur mushkilat ka saamna kar paati hai.

Ecosystem level: is darje par jaanch mein habitats ki poori range aati hai, jangalaat aur wetlands se le kar ghaas ke maidaan aur registaan tak. Is mein yeh samajhna shamil hai ke mukhtalif ecosystems kaise kaam karte hain aur majmooi ecological sehat mein kya hissa daalte hain.

blocks.text: Random sampling (be-tarteeb namoona lena) ecological studies mein kisi khaas ilaqe ki biodiversity jaanchne ka buniyadi tareeqa hai. Yeh paanch wajuhat se zaroori hai.

items: Taraf-daari (bias) kam karta hai: study area ke har hisse ko sample mein aane ka barabar mauqa milta hai, is liye nateeja majmooi biodiversity ko zyada sahih zahir karta hai.

Qabil-e-bharosa andaze (estimate) deta hai: data ka statistical tajziya (analysis) kar ke species ki tadaad (richness), afraad ki tadaad (abundance) aur phailao (distribution) ka andaza lagaya ja sakta hai.
Muqable (comparison) mein madad deta hai: data jama karne ke ek jaise (standardised) tareeqon se mukhtalif ilaqon ya habitats ka muqabla mumkin hota hai.
Numaindagi barhata hai: study area ke mukhtalif hisson ko cover kar ke random sampling yaqeeni banati hai ke sample poore ilaqe ki diversity ki numaindagi kare.
Conservation (hifazat) mein madad deta hai: sahih jaanch se zyada hifazati ahmiyat wale ilaqe pehchaane jate hain aur waqt ke saath biodiversity ki tabdeeliyon par nazar rakhi ja sakti hai.

blocks.text: Distribution ka matlab hai ke jandar kisi ilaqe mein kahan kahan paye jate hain. Teen tareeqe istemaal hote hain.

items: Quadrat sampling mein study area ko ek grid (jaali) mein baanta jata hai aur be-tarteeb (order) chune hue chaukoron, quadrats, ke andar sample liya jata hai. Yeh tareeqa podon ki aabadi aur ek jagah jure jandaron (sessile organisms) ke liye munasib hai. Misal ke taur par, jangal mein researcher ek muqarrar size ke quadrats bichhata hai aur har quadrat mein har plant species ki maujoodgi ya ghair-maujoodgi likhta hai.

Transect sampling mein study area ke aar paar ek line ya patti (transect) bichhai jati hai aur us ke saath baqaida faaslon par species note ki jati hain. Yeh badalte mahol mein species ke phailao ka mutala karne ke liye mufeed hai. Misal ke taur par, saahil par high-tide line se low-tide line tak transect bichha kar darmiyani ilaqe (intertidal) ke jandaron ki qismein aur tadaad note ki ja sakti hain.

Aerial surveys mein hawai jahaz ya drones se bare ilaqon mein jandaron ke phailao ka mushahida (observation) kiya jata hai, jaise ek bare wetland mein parindon ki species ka phailao jaanchna ya savanna mein bare mammals ki aabadi par nazar rakhna.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse. Quadrat Sampling: zameen ki ghaas par ek chaukor frame jo 25 chhote khanon mein bata hai. Transect Sampling: ek kaarkun podon wale maidan ke aar paar bichhi line ke paas baith kar line ke saath chaukor quadrat frame rakhta hai. Aerial Surveys: ek drone darakhton aur jheel wali zameen ke upar urta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Quadrat sampling mein ilaqe ko grid (jaali) mein baant kar sirf be-tarteebi se chune gaye khanon mein jandar gine jate hain. Transect sampling mein ek line (transect) gradient ke aar paar bichhai jati hai, jaise sahil par high tide line se low tide line tak, aur line ke saath barabar faaslon par record kiya jata hai. Aerial surveys mein hawai jahaz ya drone oopar se bare ilaqe ki tasveerein le kar jandaron ka phailao dekhte hain, jaise parindon ke jhund ya savanna ke bare janwar.
Abundance ka matlab hai ke kisi species ke kitne afraad hain. Paanch tareeqe bayan kiye gaye hain.

items: Point counts: ek mushahid ek muqarrar jagah se, muqarrar waqt mein, kisi species ke nazar aane wale afraad ki tadaad likhta hai. Yeh parindon aur doosre harkat karne wale janwaron ke liye aam istemaal hota hai.

Mark-recapture: afraad ko pakar kar, nishaan laga kar chhor diya jata hai, phir baad mein dobara pakar kar aabadi ka size aur density (ghanapan) ka andaza lagaya jata hai. Yeh un janwaron ke liye mufeed hai jinhein seedha ginna mushkil ho.
Quadrat counts: researcher har quadrat ke andar kisi species ke afraad ginte hain aur in ginti (count) se poori aabadi ka andaza lagate hain.
Capture-recapture models: yeh models aise mutaghayyirat (variables) ka hisaab rakhte hain jaise pakre jaane ke mukhtalif imkanat aur ilaqon ke darmiyan harkat.
Remote sensing: satellite ya drone ki tasveeron se species ki tadaad aur phailao jaancha jata hai, khaas kar bare ya na-pahunchne wale (inaccessible) ilaqon mein.

blocks.title: Tareeqa chunna
blocks.problem: Ek student jaanna chahta hai ke talaab ke kinare se khushk dhalaan tak poday kaise badalte hain, aur alag se yeh ke talaab mein kitne mendak hain. Kaun se tareeqe munasib hain?
steps: Podon ka sawal ek gradient (geela se khushk) ke aar paar phailao ke bare mein hai, is liye talaab ke kinare se dhalaan tak transect, jis par baqaida faaslon par quadrats ya records hon, sahih intikhab hai.
Mendak harkat karte aur chhupte hain, is liye unhein seedha ginna mushkil hai. Mark-recapture un ki aabadi ka andaza deta hai.
blocks.answer: Podon ke liye transect sampling; mendakon ke liye mark-recapture.

items: Biodiversity zindagi ki rang-a-rangi hai: species, genes aur ecosystems.
Ecosystem jandar aur un ka maddi mahol hai (biotic aur abiotic factors). Niche us ecosystem mein ek species ka kirdar hai.
Biodiversity species, genetic aur ecosystem darjon par jaanchi jati hai.
Random sampling bias kam karti hai, qabil-e-bharosa andaze deti hai, muqabla mumkin banati hai, sample ko numainda banati hai aur conservation mein madad deti hai.
Distribution: quadrats, transects, aerial surveys. Abundance: point counts, mark-recapture, quadrat counts, capture-recapture models, remote sensing.

blocks.prompt: Biodiversity jaanchne ke teen darje batayein, aur phailao ka ek tareeqa aur tadaad ka ek tareeqa batayein, is ke saath ke har ek kis qisam ke jandar ke liye munasib hai.
blocks.explanation: Species, genetic aur ecosystem darje. Distribution: quadrat sampling podon aur sessile jandaron ke liye munasib hai (ya gradient ke liye transects, bare ilaqon ke liye aerial surveys). Abundance: point counts parindon aur harkat karne wale janwaron ke liye; mark-recapture un janwaron ke liye jinhein seedha ginna mushkil ho.
